op22 — GVR op#21 vs 4 rivals · temporal-synth FIXED hit-rate dataop22 — GVR op#21 对 4 个对手 · 固定 hit-rate 时序合成数据

2026-07-07 · B200 (sm_100), GPU0 · branch omni/op21-gvr-prod · bucket indexer_topk_op_bench/op22_temporal_fixed_hr_bench/

Apples-to-apples comparison of the production-dispatch GVR kernel op#21 (gvr_ms_auto, iter12 @f51f50f4da) against 4 rivals, on temporally-coherent synthetic data whose temporal-hint quality (hit rate) is controlled: GVR seeds its threshold search from the previous step's top-K hint, so its cost depends on the hint, while the radix/streaming rivals are hint-blind (§6 shows the dependence is on threshold-init quality and is NON-monotone in hit rate). Timing = nsys pure-kernel GPU time (per-cell NVTX range projection; the L2-evict kernel is excluded). Two L2 regimes: cold-L2 (512 MB flush before each launch — canonical, isolated worst case) and warm-L2 (logits hot in L2 — models the fused indexer→top-K path). Three scenarios: BEST (deep-layer marginal, hr=0.90), WORST (shallow-layer marginal, hr=0.05) and REAL (aggregate layer mixture, hr sampled from the real per-step distribution — the anchor comparable to report/report.html). Section 6 resolves the mechanism behind the stress-scenario losses; Section 7 brackets op21 with deterministic best/worst-case constructions (op23).

对生产 dispatch 的 GVR 内核 op#21（gvr_ms_auto， iter12 @f51f50f4da）与 4 个对手做同口径对比，数据为 时序提示质量（hit rate）受控的时序相关合成数据： GVR 以上一步 top-K 提示为阈值搜索种子，代价依赖提示质量， 而 radix/streaming 对手对提示不敏感（§6 证明该依赖实为 『阈值初始化质量』，且对 hit rate 非单调）。计时 = nsys 纯 kernel GPU 时间（按 cell 的 NVTX 区间投影；L2 清空 kernel 已排除）。两种 L2 状态：冷 L2（每次启动前清空 512 MB —— 规范化、隔离的最坏情况）与 热 L2 （logits 驻留 L2 —— 模拟融合 indexer→top-K 路径）。三场景： BEST（深层 marginal，hr=0.90）、WORST （浅层 marginal，hr=0.05）、REAL（aggregate 层混合、 hr 按真实 per-step 分布采样 —— 与 report/report.html 可比的锚点）。 第 6 节收口了应力场景失利的机制；第 7 节用 确定性最优/最差构造为 op21 定界（op23）。

Deterministic reproduction & SKILL invocation

确定性复现与 SKILL 调用

Seed policy: synthesize() draws the row's layer as the FIRST rng call, so a constant seed would collapse the layer mixture across the grid. Per-cell seed(K,N) = 42 + crc32("{K}|{N}") % 1e6, shared across dtypes and scenarios; fully deterministic from base 42. Realised hr verified ±0.03 per bundle (G5).

Canonical CLI (verbatim; recorded per bundle in meta.json.gen_cmd):

SKILL=.claude/skills/indexer-topk-temporal-synth
# per cell (model, dtype, N): seed = 42 + crc32("{K}|{N}") % 1e6   (see seed policy)
python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py --model {v4flash|v4pro|v32} --N <N> \
    --cfg beta_deep    --target_hr 0.90 --bs 1 --dtype <dt> --seed <seed> --outdir bundles/best/...   # BEST
python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py ... --cfg beta_shallow --target_hr 0.05 ...                  # WORST
python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py ... --cfg aggregate                    ...                  # REAL (hr sampled)
# every bundle's exact CLI incl. resolved seed: bundles/<scen>/<model>_<dt>_N<N>/*/meta.json "gen_cmd"

Natural-language prompt equivalent:

使用 indexer-topk-temporal-synth skill 为 {V4-Flash|V4-Pro|V3.2} 生成 N=<N>、dtype=<dtype>、seed=<cell_seed> 的单行 decode logits + 时序相关 preIdx；GVR 最优场景用 deep-layer 分布 (--cfg beta_deep) 且固定 hit rate 0.90，GVR 最差场景用 shallow-layer 分布 (--cfg beta_shallow) 且固定 hit rate 0.05，realistic 锚点用 --cfg aggregate 并让 hit rate 按真实 per-step 分布采样。

Seed 策略：synthesize() 的第一次 rng 调用就是抽层，常量 seed 会让全网格 塌缩到同一层。每 cell seed(K,N) = 42 + crc32("{K}|{N}") % 1e6，跨 dtype 与场景共享； 从基 42 完全确定。每 bundle 实测 hr 校验 ±0.03（G5）。

规范 CLI（逐字；每个 bundle 的 meta.json.gen_cmd 记录了带解析 seed 的等价命令）：

SKILL=.claude/skills/indexer-topk-temporal-synth
# per cell (model, dtype, N): seed = 42 + crc32("{K}|{N}") % 1e6   (see seed policy)
python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py --model {v4flash|v4pro|v32} --N <N> \
    --cfg beta_deep    --target_hr 0.90 --bs 1 --dtype <dt> --seed <seed> --outdir bundles/best/...   # BEST
python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py ... --cfg beta_shallow --target_hr 0.05 ...                  # WORST
python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py ... --cfg aggregate                    ...                  # REAL (hr sampled)
# every bundle's exact CLI incl. resolved seed: bundles/<scen>/<model>_<dt>_N<N>/*/meta.json "gen_cmd"

第 1-2 节已于 2026-07-08 重测（B200，跨节点混合——同 SKU：real seq-len fp32/bf16 采于 umbriel-b200-047；fp32/bf16 real+best 与 fp16 real-K512/1024 在 umbriel-b200-037；worst fp32/bf16、fp16 K2048 及 fp16 best/worst-K512/1024 在 umbriel-b200-044；每批主机见 driver 日志；kernel HEAD 51be558e77 = op21 iter16，nsys cold-L2 协议不变，20 cold / 50 warm reps）。场景定义采用 op24 的 radix-相对全网格平均两极（本报告 §8.3b）：best = 各 K 的顺风 cfg + 固定 hr 0.55（K512 aggregate / K1024 beta_moderate / K2048 beta_shallow），worst = beta_shallow + hr 0.05，real = aggregate + 采样 hr（定义不变，bundle 逐字节复用）。算子集合：GVR-1CTA（gvr_cutedsl，基线 —— 加速比 = t(GVR-1CTA)/t(算子)，>1 ⇒ 该算子更快）、op21-legacy（HLS 前：FALSI=0+DIST=0）、HLS（op21 当前 ship 默认 @HEAD）、Radix（radix_cutedsl）、SGLang（仅 fp32 且 K≤1024）。每个测试点所有算子读取同一份 bundle 行（一次生成、共享输入）；BS=1 处每臂逐格精确性校验。旧的第 1-2 节数据集（op21-相对场景、rival/op21 比值、含 ub/lb 曲线）保留于 op22_seqlen_data.csv / op22_bs_data.csv；第 3-7 节仍描述旧数据集。

GVR-mCTA arm added 2026-07-09 (gvr_multicta_cutedsl — the multi-CTA/cluster GVR top-K from PR#15198 incl. its host-side cluster_size auto-dispatch {N<65536→1; BS≤16 & N≥65536→4; rows×2≤SMs→2; else 1}, i.e. the single-/multi-CTA MIXED dispatch as it would ship). Measured on umbriel-b200-074 (same B200 SKU, same bundles byte-for-byte, same nsys cold-L2 protocol, 20 cold / 50 warm reps, kernel HEAD unchanged) TOGETHER with a co-located GVR-1CTA anchor re-run; plotted µs are anchor-transferred onto the original baseline scale (us_mc × us_base(orig)/us_base(074) per cell), so its speedup curve is the same-node ratio. Per-cell exactness validated at BS=1. Raw 074 values in op22rr_mc_raw074.csv.

GVR-mCTA 臂已于 2026-07-09 补充（gvr_multicta_cutedsl —— PR#15198 的多 CTA/cluster GVR top-K，含其 host 侧 cluster_size 自动调度 {N<65536→1；BS≤16 且 N≥65536→4；rows×2≤SM 数→2；否则 1}，即上线形态的单/多 CTA 混合调度）。采集于 umbriel-b200-074（同 B200 SKU、bundle 逐字节相同、nsys cold-L2 协议不变、20 cold / 50 warm reps、kernel HEAD 不变），并与 GVR-1CTA 锚点臂同机复测；图中 µs 已按 cell 锚点迁移到原基线刻度（us_mc × us_base(orig)/us_base(074)），因此其加速比曲线即同机比值。BS=1 处逐格精确性校验。074 原始值见 op22rr_mc_raw074.csv。

1. Seq-len sweep (BS=1)1. 序列长度扫描（BS=1）

Per (K, dtype): latency (top) and op21-speedup (bottom) vs N, three scenarios side-by-side — the reference report's latency+speedup pairing. In REAL, each N cell draws its own layer + hr (by design), so N-trends are jagged — judge per-cell ratios, not curve smoothness.

每 (K, dtype)：延迟（上）与 op21 加速比（下）对 N，三场景并排 —— 即参考报告的延迟+加速比成对版式。REAL 场景每个 N cell 独立抽层与 hr（设计使然），N 趋势有锯齿 —— 看每 cell 的比值，不看曲线平滑度。

5. Findings — extreme cells (op21 vs Radix)5. Findings — 极端 cell（op21 对 Radix）

Per scenario, the 5 worst and 5 best cells by radix/op21 time ratio (active L2 regime), with the cell's hit-rate, source layer and op21 dispatch path — the raw material for regime analysis. §6 identifies the mechanism behind the loss cells: extra full-row re-scans triggered by poisoned threshold-init, a pure function of the preIdx hint (NOT value tie-density, and NOT monotone in hr).

每场景按 radix/op21 时间比（当前 L2 状态）列最差 5 个与最好 5 个 cell，附该 cell 的 hit-rate、来源层与 op21 dispatch 路径 —— regime 分析的原始素材。失利 cell 背后的机制见 §6：阈值初始化被污染导致的额外全行重扫，纯粹由 preIdx 提示决定（与 value tie 密度无关，对 hr 也非单调）。

6. Mechanism — why hr=0.90 slows the GVR family down6. 机制 — 为什么 hr=0.90 反而拖慢整个 GVR 家族

Verdict: the BEST-scenario slowdown is real and data-dependent, but the tie-density hypothesis is falsified. The cost driver is the number of extra full-row re-scans during threshold search, and that number is a pure function of the preIdx hint — not of the logits value distribution. Chain of evidence (full detail: MECH_FINDINGS.md, artifacts mech_check_iters.py/.jsonl, mech_crossover.py):

  1. Non-convergence never happens. A verified host replay of the vendored kernel's control flow (harness/count_gvr_iters.py) on the actual bundles: P2 converges in 162/162 cells, all scenarios.
    scenariocellsP2 refine iters med/maxfull-row count evals med/maxP2 non-convergedP4 snap iters med/max
    BEST (beta_deep, hr=0.90)541 / 72 / 80/543 / 23
    WORST (beta_shallow, hr=0.05)540 / 01 / 10/542 / 13
    REAL (aggregate, sampled hr)541 / 52 / 60/542 / 12
  2. GVR single-CTA obeys a linear law in eval count, scenario drops out: K2048 fp32 N=1M ev1→93.3 µs, ev3→136.7 µs (≈22 µs per extra full-row scan); best/real N=524K both ev4 → 86.2/86.3 µs (identical).
  3. Crossover experiment (decisive): swap logits and preIdx between the best and real bundles at the headline cells (CUDA-event median, 50 cold reps, b200-049 GPU1, screening-only). Cost follows the preIdx column only:
    op / cell (N=1M fp32)lg=best,pi=bestlg=best,pi=real lg=real,pi=bestlg=real,pi=real
    ms_auto K2048247.840.7229.140.5
    cutedsl K2048146.0103.1168.0102.3
    ms_auto K512125.0187.0124.5186.2
    cutedsl K512123.9125.7125.5128.0
    K512 flips the sign (real-preIdx slower than best-preIdx) ⇒ NON-monotone in hit rate.
  4. Why hr→1 poisons the init: GVR seeds the threshold with mean(logits[preIdx]). A near-perfect hint makes that ≈ the top-K median → initial count ≈ K/2 < K → guaranteed undershoot → 1–3 refine re-scans. Boundary-clustered misses (REAL, and WORST whose miss-depth model sits at the selection boundary) put the seed ≈ the K-th value → first count already lands in the [K, kC] acceptance band.
  5. op21's cliff is sharper: on a ladder miss or slot overflow the msc kernels take the leader-CTA full-row fallback (gvr_msc_op.py:1096, ~95 µs per pass at N=1M fp32) — 236 µs (ev3) vs 28.6 µs (ev1) at the headline cell. K512 shows the overflow trigger alone: all crossover combos replay ev2, but real-preIdx yields cand≈4500 (> slot cap) vs 654 → fallback → 186 vs 124 µs.

Prediction check (build-time) — replay says WORST needs zero refines (ev1 in 54/54 cells) ⇒ the refine trigger is absent; the single-CTA/multi-CTA GVR should match REAL. op21's msc paths carry the second trigger: worst's boundary-flat data yields wide candidate bands (replay cand→kC, e.g. 4318 at K2048 N=1M) → slot-overflow fallback, so ms_auto may stay slower than REAL at hugeN even with ev1. Geomean tworst/treal on matched cells (<1 ⇒ worst faster): GVR op#21 ms_auto (production dispatch) 1.142× (n=906) · GVR single-CTA (cuteDSL #14602) 0.769× (n=906) · GVR multi-CTA (cuteDSL, PR#15198) 0.791× (n=906) · Radix (cuteDSL) 1.005× (n=906) · SGLang StreamingTopK (fp32, K≤1024) 0.999× (n=210). Caveat: worst ran on b200-049, real on b200-040 — cross-node absolute-µs comparison, treat direction-only.

Methodology note: a synthetic FIXED hr≥0.9 preIdx is a stress construction — real captures never place the hint mean at the top-K median, because real misses concentrate at the selection boundary.

结论：BEST 场景的变慢是真实、数据依赖的，但 tie 密度假设被证伪。 代价来自阈值搜索期间的额外全行重扫次数，而该次数是 preIdx 提示的纯函数 —— 与 logits 值分布无关。证据链（详见 MECH_FINDINGS.md，工件 mech_check_iters.py/.jsonl、mech_crossover.py）：

  1. 非收敛从未发生。用忠实复刻内核控制流的 host 回放 （harness/count_gvr_iters.py）在真实 bundle 上：162/162 cell P2 全收敛。
    scenariocellsP2 refine iters med/maxfull-row count evals med/maxP2 non-convergedP4 snap iters med/max
    BEST (beta_deep, hr=0.90)541 / 72 / 80/543 / 23
    WORST (beta_shallow, hr=0.05)540 / 01 / 10/542 / 13
    REAL (aggregate, sampled hr)541 / 52 / 60/542 / 12
  2. GVR 单 CTA 的用时是 eval 次数的线性函数，场景变量消失：K2048 fp32 N=1M ev1→93.3 µs、ev3→136.7 µs（每次额外全行扫描 ≈22 µs）；best/real N=524K 同为 ev4 → 86.2/86.3 µs（完全一致）。
  3. 交叉实验（决定性）：在头条 cell 上把 best 与 real 的 logits、preIdx 两两互换 （CUDA-event 中位数，50 次 cold，b200-049 GPU1，仅筛查用）。用时只跟随 preIdx 列：
    op / cell (N=1M fp32)lg=best,pi=bestlg=best,pi=real lg=real,pi=bestlg=real,pi=real
    ms_auto K2048247.840.7229.140.5
    cutedsl K2048146.0103.1168.0102.3
    ms_auto K512125.0187.0124.5186.2
    cutedsl K512123.9125.7125.5128.0
    K512 方向反转（real-preIdx 反而比 best-preIdx 慢）⇒ 对 hit rate 非单调。
  4. 为什么 hr→1 会毒化初始化：GVR 用 mean(logits[preIdx]) 作阈值种子。近乎完美的 提示使它 ≈ top-K 的中位数 → 初始计数 ≈ K/2 < K → 必然 undershoot → 1–3 次 refine 重扫。而边界聚集的 miss（REAL，以及 miss-depth 模型贴着选择边界的 WORST）使种子 ≈ 第 K 个值 → 首次计数即落入 [K, kC] 接受带。
  5. op21 的悬崖更陡：ladder 未命中或 slot 溢出时，msc 内核走 leader-CTA 全行 fallback（gvr_msc_op.py:1096，N=1M fp32 每遍 ~95 µs）—— 头条 cell 236 µs（ev3）对 28.6 µs（ev1）。K512 单独展示溢出触发：交叉组合回放全为 ev2，但 real-preIdx 的 cand≈4500（超 slot 容量）对 654 → fallback → 186 对 124 µs。

预言验证（构建时计算） — 回放表明 WORST 零 refine（54/54 cell ev1）⇒ refine 触发器缺席；单 CTA/多 CTA GVR 应与 REAL 持平。op21 的 msc 路径带第二触发器：worst 的『贴边界平坦』数据产生宽候选带（回放 cand→kC，如 K2048 N=1M 时 4318）→ slot 溢出 fallback，因此 ms_auto 在 hugeN 即使 ev1 也可能仍慢于 REAL。匹配 cell 上 tworst/treal 几何均值（<1 ⇒ worst 更快）：GVR op#21 ms_auto (production dispatch) 1.142× (n=906) · GVR single-CTA (cuteDSL #14602) 0.769× (n=906) · GVR multi-CTA (cuteDSL, PR#15198) 0.791× (n=906) · Radix (cuteDSL) 1.005× (n=906) · SGLang StreamingTopK (fp32, K≤1024) 0.999× (n=210)。注意：worst 在 b200-049、real 在 b200-040 —— 跨节点绝对 µs 对比，只看方向。

方法论注记：合成的固定 hr≥0.9 preIdx 是一种应力构造 —— 真实捕获中提示 均值从不落在 top-K 中位数上，因为真实 miss 聚集在选择边界。

UB pins the P2 seed pmean into the acceptance band (single pass, ev1) AND satisfies the msc cluster fast-path gate (gvr_msc_op.py:993-996) at every cell — op21's analytic optimum on this grid. LB maximizes the stash mean (deepest undershoot) while defeating the fallback done-short-circuit (gvr_msc_op.py:1104-1116) — the leader CTA re-scans the full row 5–8×. LB is mechanism-specific, not a global input minimum: at 19/78 cells (K512 N≥32K, some K1024/K2048) REAL data is slower than the LB construction via the band/slot-overflow mechanism (§6, real-K512 cand≈4500 fallback) — hence the LB_eff column (per-cell worst of {lb, real}). Exactness gate 456/456; logits are byte-identical to the REAL bundles (only preIdx differs, backed by the §6 crossover). Full dossier: op23_op21_bounds/RESULTS_SUMMARY.md.

解读。UB 把 P2 种子 pmean 精确钉入接受带（单遍扫描 ev1），且每个 cell 都满足 msc 集群快路径门（gvr_msc_op.py:993-996）—— 是 op21 在该网格上的解析最优。LB 最大化 stash 均值（最深 undershoot），同时击破 fallback 短路种子（gvr_msc_op.py:1104-1116）—— leader CTA 全行重扫 5–8 遍。LB 是机理特定下界，不是全输入空间最小值：19/78 个 cell（K512 N≥32K 及部分 K1024/K2048）上 REAL 数据经 band/slot-溢出机理（§6，real-K512 cand≈4500 fallback）比 LB 构造更慢 —— 因此增设 LB_eff 列（按 cell 取 {lb, real} 中更差者）。精确性门 456/456；logits 与 REAL bundle 字节一致（仅 preIdx 不同，依据 §6 crossover）。完整卷宗：op23_op21_bounds/RESULTS_SUMMARY.md。

8. op24 — synthesis-parameter favorability bounds (hr sweep, all three K on silicon)8. op24 — 合成参数顺/逆风定界（hr 扫描，三档 K 上硅）

This report's three scenarios are three POINTS of the temporal-synth generator's parameter space (best = beta_deep + hr 0.90, worst = beta_shallow + hr 0.05, real = aggregate + sampled hr). op24 (2026-07-08, indexer_topk_op_bench/op24_synth_favorability/) sweeps the WHOLE space to find the actual poles, in two phases mirroring the campaign's host-probe-first discipline: Phase 1 synthesizes 392 bundles ({v4flash, v4pro, v32} × {aggregate, beta_shallow/moderate/deep} × hr {sampled, .05, .30, .55, .75, .90 | steps=1; emergent | steps=4} × N 4K–1M, BS=1 fp32, op22 cell seeds) and host-replays each one — the op21 ladder R0 admission test (proto_hls, unchanged by HLS which only re-priced the fallback) plus the original GVR's faithful control-flow replay (count_gvr_iters) — no timing involved; Phase 2 takes the screening extremes to silicon with a same-process paired FOUR-arm nsys cold-L2 A/B (orig = gvr_cutedsl / legacy = pre-HLS op21 / shipped = HLS op21 / radix = radix_cutedsl, 30 interleaved reps, sorted-set exactness; 41/41 cells exact ok ×4 arms). The true extremes are NOT this report's scenario points.

本报告的三个场景其实是 temporal-synth 生成器参数空间的三个点（best = beta_deep + hr 0.90，worst = beta_shallow + hr 0.05，real = aggregate + 采样 hr）。op24（2026-07-08，indexer_topk_op_bench/op24_synth_favorability/）遍历整个空间找真正的两极，沿用战役"host 探针先行"的两阶段纪律：Phase 1 合成 392 个 bundle（{v4flash, v4pro, v32} × {aggregate, beta_shallow/moderate/deep} × hr {采样, .05, .30, .55, .75, .90 | steps=1；涌现 | steps=4} × N 4K–1M，BS=1 fp32，op22 同源 cell seed），逐一 host 重放 —— op21 ladder 的 R0 接受测试（proto_hls；HLS 只改了 fallback 的价格、不改接受条件）+ 原始 GVR 的忠实控制流重放（count_gvr_iters）—— 全程不计时；Phase 2 把筛选极值带上硅：同进程配对四臂 nsys cold-L2 A/B（orig = gvr_cutedsl / legacy = HLS 前 op21 / shipped = HLS op21 / radix = radix_cutedsl，30 次交错 rep，排序集合精确性校验；41/41 格 × 4 臂 exact 全 ok）。真正的两极不在本报告的场景点上。

8.1 Anatomy of the hr axis (host replay, 56 bundles per row, pooled over model × cfg × N)

Fast-path admission needs one ladder rank-fraction column f ∈ {0.75, 0.5, 0.25} to land count(≥q(f)) ∈ [K, kC≈2.5K]. Since count(≥q(f)) ≈ f·K/h on stash-representative data, the window is roughly f ∈ [h, 2.5·h] — which makes hr→speed non-monotone and locates both poles analytically. The orig-GVR column is the OTHER half of every verdict: its seed is mean(logits[preIdx]), so mid-hr stashes poison it (mean ≈ mid-top-K ⇒ guaranteed undershoot ⇒ extra full-row evals) while boundary-miss stashes (hr .05) hand it a first-shot threshold.

8.1 hr 轴解剖（host 重放，每行 56 个 bundle，池化 模型 × cfg × N）

fast-path 接受要求某个 ladder rank 分数列 f ∈ {0.75, 0.5, 0.25} 的 count(≥q(f)) 落 [K, kC≈2.5K]。在 stash 具代表性时 count(≥q(f)) ≈ f·K/h，故窗口约为 f ∈ [h, 2.5·h] —— 这既解释了 hr→速度的非单调，也解析地定出两极。orig-GVR 列是每个判决的另一半：其种子 = mean(logits[preIdx])，中段 hr 的 stash 会毒它（均值 ≈ topK 中部 ⇒ 必然 undershoot ⇒ 额外全行 evals），而边界 miss 的 stash（hr .05）反而送它一发命中。

8.1b Factor decomposition — what actually makes data optimal or worst for GVR/HLS

hr is the primary axis, through TWO independent causal channels that the verdict multiplies together. Channel A (op21/HLS): hr sets where the stash's rank-quantile ladder columns land on the row's CCDF — count(≥q(f)) ≈ f·K/h — so each rung f is admissible iff roughly h ≤ f ≤ 2.5·h. Channel B (original GVR): hr sets where mean(logits[preIdx]) lands — deep inside the top-K (undershoot, extra evals) or at the selection boundary (first-shot). The analytic window reproduces the measured fast rates rung by rung, and the knife-edge at h=0.75 is exactly the window's lower boundary (f=0.75 gives count ≈ K borderline — sampling noise splits fast/band):

hrungs of {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} inside [h, 2.5h]predictedmeasured fast rateorig evals (measured)
0.05nonefallback0.001.20
0.300.5, 0.75fast (2 rungs)0.801.43
0.550.75 (mid-window)fast0.932.91
0.750.75 (knife-edge: count≈K)marginal0.293.88
0.90none (only the g_min anchor)fallback0.003.75

Channel B is monotone-rising and SATURATES: orig's punishment climbs 1.20 → 3.88 evals up to h=0.75, then flattens (3.75 at 0.90 — the mean-seed is already mid-top-K; going deeper adds no evals). So the joint optimum is NOT where orig suffers most (0.75) but where op21's fast rate is still ~1 while orig already pays ~3 evals — h≈0.55, and the optimum is structural, not a grid artifact. Erosion inside the window is the collect-capacity constraint, which is K2048-specific: cap 4096 < kC 5120, so at h∈{0.30, 0.55} every overflow case in the screen sits at K2048 (2–5 of 8 per cfg) — the reason v32's argmax is sampled-hr/moderate rather than hr0.55-any-cfg.

Secondary factors, ranked:

factorsizemechanism & evidence
cfg (marginal shape)ev ±0.9, fast ±0.07tail weight moves orig's mean-seed: heavier tail (beta_deep) pulls pmean toward high values → FEWER refine evals (ev 2.50) vs moderate 3.36 / aggregate 3.00 / shallow 2.79 at h=0.55; shallow's flat boundary maximizes all_ge purity on the adversarial side
Kfavorable side onlyo/s grows 1.75 → 1.86 → 2.14 with K (orig's per-pass cost ∝ K: P1 gather, cr=1 at K2048); adversarial side K-flat 0.76–0.86 (fallback economics and radix's bar are K-insensitive); K2048 adds the collect-cap erosion above
Nshape of the profileN < 65536 = ms_1cta, no C-slicing, small absolute stakes; 65K–262K = the pain zone (each fallback ≈ one leader FULL-row pass on top of a C-sliced fast base — and the deployment envelope's main battlefield); N ≥ 524288 = HLS dist fallback slices the fallback too → adversarial o/s flips positive (1.34 at 1M) regardless of hr
steps (temporal model)moderatesteps=4 copula closed loop (preIdx = topK of previous row): hr becomes emergent from lag-1 ρ (0.79–0.98) → fast 0.73, ev 2.23 — production-faithful but NOT steerable; use steps=1 + target_hr to construct poles
dtypefavorable amplifier16-bit amplifies the HLS side (op21 iter15: real-axis o/s fp32 1.667 → bf16 2.040; K2048 falsi tax vanishes in 16-bit)
BSadversarial deepener (out of this sweep)this sweep is BS=1 by design; at BS ≥ 64 op21 dispatches ms_1cta where the dist fallback does not exist — iter15's high-BS worst was 0/25 for HLS — so an adversarial construction at high BS would be even deeper

Portrait of the optimal bundle (for GVR/HLS): stash is ~55% true top-K members with misses placed in the boundary band; marginal with a real-weight tail so the boundary region is sparse (rank columns resolve, no overflow); every N on the fast path; orig forced into 3–4 refine scans by the mid-top-K mean-seed. Portrait of the worst bundle: stash almost entirely misses BUT all misses hugging the selection boundary (that is what makes orig converge first-shot — deep random misses would hurt orig too); flat/shallow marginal so every rank column's count blows past kC (all_ge each row); N capped at 262144 to keep the HLS dist rescue out of reach.

8.1b 因素分解 —— 究竟什么让数据对 GVR/HLS 最优或最坏

hr 是首要轴，通过两条独立因果通道起作用，判决是两者的乘积。通道 A（op21/HLS）：hr 决定 stash 的 rank-quantile ladder 列落在行 CCDF 的哪里 —— count(≥q(f)) ≈ f·K/h —— 故每个 rung f 可接受当且仅当约 h ≤ f ≤ 2.5·h。通道 B（原始 GVR）：hr 决定 mean(logits[preIdx]) 落在哪 —— top-K 深处（undershoot、额外 evals）或选择边界（一发命中）。解析窗逐点复现实测 fast 率，h=0.75 的刀锋正是窗的下边界（f=0.75 时 count ≈ K 恰在带边 —— 采样噪声把 fast/band 各分一半）：

h{0.25, 0.5, 0.75} 中落入 [h, 2.5h] 的 rung预测实测 fast 率orig evals（实测）
0.05无fallback0.001.20
0.300.5, 0.75fast（2 列）0.801.43
0.550.75（窗中部）fast0.932.91
0.750.75（刀锋：count≈K）边缘0.293.88
0.90无（只剩 g_min 锚）fallback0.003.75

通道 B 单调上升且饱和：orig 的惩罚从 1.20 evals 爬到 h=0.75 的 3.88，随后走平（0.90 处 3.75 —— 均值种子已在 topK 中部，再深也不加 evals）。所以联合最优不在 orig 最痛处（0.75），而在 op21 fast 率仍 ~1、orig 已付 ~3 evals 的位置 —— h≈0.55，这个最优点是结构性的，不是网格伪影。窗内的侵蚀来自 collect 容量约束，且是 K2048 特异：cap 4096 < kC 5120，h∈{0.30, 0.55} 的筛选里所有 overflow 都落在 K2048（每 cfg 8 格中 2–5 格）—— 这正是 v32 的 argmax 是采样 hr/moderate 而非 hr0.55-任意 cfg 的原因。

次要因素，按影响排序：

因素量级机制与证据
cfg（边缘分布形状）ev ±0.9，fast ±0.07尾重决定 orig 均值种子的位置：尾越重（beta_deep）pmean 越被拉向高值 → refine evals 越少（ev 2.50），对比 moderate 3.36 / aggregate 3.00 / shallow 2.79（h=0.55）；shallow 的平坦边界让逆风侧 all_ge 最纯
K仅顺风侧o/s 随 K 增：1.75 → 1.86 → 2.14（orig 单遍成本 ∝ K：P1 gather，K2048 还是 cr=1）；逆风侧 K-平坦 0.76–0.86（fallback 经济学与 radix 地板都对 K 不敏感）；K2048 另有上述 collect-cap 侵蚀
N决定 profile 形状N < 65536 = ms_1cta，无 C 切片、绝对量小；65K–262K = 痛区（每次 fallback ≈ 在 C 切片的 fast 基础上多付一个 leader 全行 pass —— 也是部署包络的主战场）；N ≥ 524288 = HLS dist fallback 把 fallback 也切片 → 逆风 o/s 无论 hr 都转正（1M 处 1.34）
steps（时序模型）中等steps=4 copula 闭环（preIdx = 上一行的 topK）：hr 由 lag-1 ρ（0.79–0.98）涌现 → fast 0.73、ev 2.23 —— 贴生产语义但不可控；构造两极请用 steps=1 + target_hr
dtype顺风放大器16-bit 放大 HLS 侧（op21 iter15：real 轴 o/s fp32 1.667 → bf16 2.040；K2048 falsi 税在 16-bit 消失）
BS逆风加深器（本遍历之外）本遍历按设计 BS=1；BS ≥ 64 时 op21 走 ms_1cta，该路径没有 dist fallback —— iter15 高 BS worst 段 HLS 0/25 —— 高 BS 的逆风构造会更深

最优 bundle 画像（对 GVR/HLS）：stash ~55% 是真 top-K 成员、miss 放在边界带；边缘分布带真实权重的尾（边界区稀疏 → rank 列可分辨、无 overflow）；全 N 走 fast path；orig 被 topK 中部的均值种子逼进 3–4 次 refine 全行扫。最坏 bundle 画像：stash 几乎全是 miss 但全部贴着选择边界（这正是 orig 一发命中的原因 —— 若 miss 深部随机，orig 也会挨罚）；平坦/shallow 边缘让每个 rank 列的 count 全部冲破 kC（每行 all_ge）；N 压在 262144 以内，让 HLS 的 dist 兜底够不着。

8.3 Paste-ready synthesis prompts

Both prompts drive the indexer-topk-temporal-synth skill (natural-language trigger or direct CLI). Swap --model/--cfg per the 8.2 table; bf16 logits amplify the favorable margin further (op21 iter15: 16-bit real-axis o/s up to 2.04×). Seeds: any fixed seed reproduces; op24 used the op22 cell-seed policy for anchor comparability.

8.3 可直接粘贴的合成 prompt

两个 prompt 都驱动 indexer-topk-temporal-synth skill（自然语言触发或直接 CLI）。--model/--cfg 按 8.2 表替换；bf16 logits 可进一步放大顺风侧（op21 iter15：16-bit real 轴 o/s 最高 2.04×）。种子：任意固定 seed 均可复现；op24 为锚点可比性沿用 op22 的 cell-seed 策略。

FAVORABLE — "Use indexer-topk-temporal-synth to synthesize V4 Pro indexer data engineered as the HLS/op21-GVR tailwind case (BS=1, seq_len 4K–1M): fixed hit-rate 0.55, beta_moderate marginal, single step." Key lever: hr 0.55 keeps every N on the op21 fast path while poisoning the original GVR's mean-seed into 3–4 extra full-row evals.

顺风 —— 「用 indexer-topk-temporal-synth 合成 DSV4 Pro indexer 数据，构造 HLS/op21-GVR 顺风场景（BS=1，seq_len 4K–1M）：hit-rate 固定 0.55，beta_moderate 边缘分布，单步。」关键杠杆：hr 0.55 让 op21 全 N 免 fallback，同时把原始 GVR 的均值种子毒成 3–4 个额外全行 evals。

SKILL=.claude/skills/indexer-topk-temporal-synth
for N in 4096 16384 65536 262144 1048576; do
  python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py --model v4pro \
    --cfg beta_moderate --target_hr 0.55 --steps 1 --bs 1 \
    --dtype fp32 --N $N --seed 42 --outdir <outdir>/N$N
done
# K512: --model v4flash --cfg aggregate      (o/s 1.753)
# K2048: --model v32 --cfg beta_moderate     (sampled-hr default ~= argmax, o/s 2.138; --target_hr 0.55 tied)

ADVERSARIAL — "Use indexer-topk-temporal-synth to synthesize V4 Pro indexer data engineered as the HLS/op21-GVR headwind case (BS=1, seq_len 4K–1M): fixed hit-rate 0.05, beta_shallow marginal, single step." Key lever: hr 0.05 puts every ladder column count above kC (all_ge fallback each row) while boundary misses hand the original GVR a first-shot threshold (ev=1). For a PURE headwind grid restrict to N ≤ 262144 — at N ≥ 524288 the HLS distributed fallback rescues the tail (o/s 1.3–1.7).

逆风 —— 「用 indexer-topk-temporal-synth 合成 DSV4 Pro indexer 数据，构造 HLS/op21-GVR 逆风场景（BS=1，seq_len 4K–1M）：hit-rate 固定 0.05，beta_shallow 边缘分布，单步。」关键杠杆：hr 0.05 使所有 ladder 列 count 超 kC（每行 all_ge fallback），而边界 miss 送给原始 GVR 一发命中的阈值（ev=1）。要构造纯逆风网格请限制 N ≤ 262144 —— N ≥ 524288 时 HLS 分布式 fallback 会把尾部救回（o/s 1.3–1.7）。

SKILL=.claude/skills/indexer-topk-temporal-synth
for N in 4096 16384 65536 262144; do   # pure headwind: stop at 262144
  python3 $SKILL/src/synth_temporal_data.py --model v4pro \
    --cfg beta_shallow --target_hr 0.05 --steps 1 --bs 1 \
    --dtype fp32 --N $N --seed 42 --outdir <outdir>/N$N
done
# same recipe on v4flash / v32: o/s 0.857 / 0.759 (K-flat)

8.3b Re-ranking under a radix-relative objective (favorable = best GRID-AVERAGE radix/HLS, adversarial = worst)

Redefining the poles against radix — as the geomean of radix/HLS over the FULL 4K–1M grid, not per-cell — is answerable from the SAME silicon data (every op24 run carries the radix arm). The premise is measured, not assumed: radix_cutedsl is data-oblivious — across all 9 combos its time at fixed (K,N) spreads ≤2.7%. So synthesis can only move the HLS side, and the achievable per-cell range collapses outside one N band:

N bandachievable radix/HLS (measured, min → max over the parameter space)dominated by
4K–16K0.30 → 0.63both kernels floor-bound; radix always wins, data barely moves it
65K–262K0.39 → 1.38the only per-cell winnable band — data swings the ratio ~2.6×
1M0.29 → 0.57radix full-GPU bandwidth vs op21's C≤8 CTAs; no data rescues it

Consequence of the average definition: NO synthesizable data reaches grid-average parity with radix. The 4K–16K floor cells and the 1M bandwidth cell drag every geomean below 1.0 regardless of hr/cfg — per-cell wins exist only at 65K–262K (up to 1.377 @ K1024 65K). Measured grid averages across the 9 silicon combos:

combogrid-average radix/HLS (gm)
best averagev32 aggregate hr-sampled / v32 beta_shallow hr0.55 (deterministic twin)0.895 / 0.892 (grid 16K–1M — K2048's N>2K constraint excludes 4096)
best average incl. the 4096 pointv4pro beta_moderate hr0.550.774 (5-N grid)
v4flash aggregate hr0.550.659
worst averagev4flash beta_shallow hr0.050.398 (K1024 0.406 / K2048 0.413 — K-flat)

Why K2048 wins the average: its grid legitimately starts at 16K, its 16K floor cell is the least bad (0.80 vs 0.62 at K1024), and its 1M cell holds 0.75 vs 0.54 — while its winnable band sits at ~1.00–1.08. The hr mechanism itself is unchanged: any fast-path-heavy combo (hr 0.55 fixed or sampled) is within ~3% of the model's ceiling; hr 0.05 is the worst everywhere.

8.3b 换成 radix-相对目标的重排（顺风 = 全网格平均 radix/HLS 最优，逆风 = 最差）

把两极改为相对 radix 定义 —— 取 radix/HLS 在完整 4K–1M 网格上的几何均值，而非逐格 —— 用同一批硅上数据即可回答（op24 每个 run 都带 radix 臂）。前提是实测而非假设：radix_cutedsl 数据无感 —— 固定 (K,N) 下跨全部 9 个 combo 的时间波动 ≤2.7%。于是合成只能移动 HLS 一侧，且逐格可达范围在一个 N 段之外全面塌缩：

N 段可达 radix/HLS（实测，参数空间 min → max）主导因素
4K–16K0.30 → 0.63双方 floor 主导；radix 恒赢，数据几乎推不动
65K–262K0.39 → 1.38唯一逐格能赢的段 —— 数据可造 ~2.6× 摆幅
1M0.29 → 0.57radix 全机带宽 vs op21 的 C≤8 CTA；任何数据救不了

平均定义的直接后果：没有任何可合成数据能在全网格平均上追平 radix。4K–16K 的 floor 格与 1M 的带宽格把所有几何均值拖到 1.0 以下，与 hr/cfg 无关 —— 逐格的赢只存在于 65K–262K（最高 1.377 @ K1024 65K）。9 个硅上 combo 的全网格平均实测：

# mechanism: hr0.05 = all_ge fallback every row; its own contribution is the
# 65K-262K depression (0.60 -> 0.39); the 4K/1M cells are radix-won by N-structure anyway

Ceiling statement (ships with the recipe): the grid-average optimum ≈ 0.9 and the per-cell maximum 1.38 are STRUCTURAL ceilings, not data shortfalls — at 65K–262K the HLS fast path is floor-dominated (<2 µs of its ~18.5 µs is pure scan bandwidth) against radix's fixed ~20 µs pipeline, and outside that band N-structure decides. Triangulates with §7 op23's analytic UB (vs radix 0.851 pooled) and the op12/op20 "1.5×-everywhere unreachable" wall. Pushing beyond requires kernel levers (cheaper-P2 floor, more CTAs per row), not synthesis parameters.

天花板声明（须随配方交付）：全网格平均最优 ≈ 0.9 与逐格最高 1.38 都是结构性上限，不是数据不够顺 —— 65K–262K 段 HLS fast path 是 floor 主导（~18.5 µs 里纯扫带宽 <2 µs）对 radix 固定 ~20 µs 流水，该段之外由 N 结构决定。这与 §7 op23 的解析上界（vs radix 0.851 池化）和 op12/op20 的 "1.5×-everywhere 不可达"墙互证。要推得更高，杠杆在 kernel（cheaper-P2 降 floor、增加单行 CTA 数），不在合成参数。

8.4 Caveats & how to read these numbers

  • Favorable-case numbers are favorable-case numbers. hr 0.55 sits at the LOW edge of the real per-layer hr means (0.54–0.90), so the tailwind construction is real-plausible-ish; fixed hr 0.05 with a shallow marginal is far outside real capture behaviour (real misses concentrate at the selection boundary and per-step hr never approaches 0.05). Final verdicts stay on real captures.
  • Deployment envelope (production has no ISL≥1M ⇒ N≤262144 is what matters): favorable K1024 gm 1.62 with outright radix wins at 65K/262K; adversarial gm 0.68. The 1M cells are stress probes.
  • o/s spread 0.76→2.14 brackets the §7 op23 deterministic envelope from inside the generator's own parameter space — two independent routes to the same data-sensitivity band.
  • The sampled-real-hr anchors land near the favorable pole at K2048 (1.95 vs argmax 2.14) but mid-range at K1024 (1.41 vs 1.86) — K2048's admission window is wide enough that real hr draws mostly fall inside it.
  • Full screening table, per-cell jsonl, scripts and gotchas (screening score column is mis-calibrated in absolute terms — rank by fast-rate/ev only; a state-dependent cuteDSL DSLRuntimeError once hit a batch process, clean on fresh rerun): indexer_topk_op_bench/op24_synth_favorability/RESULTS.md.

8.4 告诫与读数方式

  • 顺风数字只是顺风数字。hr 0.55 位于真实逐层 hr 均值区间（0.54–0.90）的低端，顺风构造尚属贴真；固定 hr 0.05 + shallow 边缘分布则远超真实捕获行为（真实 miss 集中在选择边界，逐步 hr 从不接近 0.05）。最终判决必须回真实 capture。
  • 部署包络（生产无 ISL≥1M ⇒ 关键区是 N≤262144）：顺风 K1024 gm 1.62 且 65K/262K 正面赢 radix；逆风 gm 0.68。1M 格是应力探针。
  • o/s 跨度 0.76→2.14 从生成器自身参数空间内部框住了 §7 op23 的确定性包络 —— 两条独立路线得到同一条数据敏感度带。
  • 采样真实 hr 的锚点在 K2048 靠近顺风极（1.95 对 argmax 2.14）、在 K1024 居中（1.41 对 1.86）—— K2048 的接受窗足够宽，真实 hr 抽样大多落在窗内。
  • 完整筛选表、逐格 jsonl、脚本与坑（筛选 score 列绝对值失准 —— 只按 fast 率/ev 排序；批进程曾偶发状态依赖的 cuteDSL DSLRuntimeError，新进程重跑即净）：indexer_topk_op_bench/op24_synth_favorability/RESULTS.md。
